description: This Kotlin file defines the singleton object QuickLaunch which provides a method to attach a click listener to a button. When the button is clicked, it starts PlaybackActivity with a fixed content ID, facilitating quick access to playback from other parts of the app.

classes.name: QuickLaunch
classes.description: A singleton object that provides a method to attach a click listener to a button for launching PlaybackActivity.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Binds a click listener to the given button that starts PlaybackActivity with a predefined content ID.
